prompt: slow emotional piano ballad, cinematic r&b, soft strings, warm pads, minimal drums, 65 bpm, intimate, reflective, heartbreaking, hopeful, mother tribute, male vocals, breathy vocals, tender build, emotional outro
lyrics:
[verse 1]
Before I knew the weight of pain
You carried yours so quietly
A dream once lived inside your legs
An athlete’s fire, wild and free

You ran toward every morning
With a heart that would not bend
Then one hard day changed everything
But your love did not end

[pre-chorus]
I think of all the nights you hid
The tears you never let me see
You broke in silence, piece by piece
So I could still believe

[chorus]
Mother, I know
You gave your whole life to mine
You held the dark inside your hands
And told me I would shine

Mother, I know
The world was heavy on your soul
But you stayed because of me
Now I live because you held on

[verse 2]
You taught me when my hands were small
You shaped my dreams with tired eyes
You gave me books, you gave me hope
You gave me every chance to rise

Even when your mind was hurting
Even when trust left you betrayed
Even when the world took from you
You still found a way

[pre-chorus]
I didn’t know how much it cost
To send me further than your pain
Now every door I walk through
Still echoes with your name

[chorus]
Mother, I know
You gave your whole life to mine
You held the dark inside your hands
And told me I would shine

Mother, I know
The world was heavy on your soul
But you stayed because of me
Now I live because you held on

[bridge]
I have been away for years now
But distance never made love fade
I graduated, found my road
Just like you once prayed

And when you say that you are proud
I hear the years you never spoke
All the nights you kept on breathing
When you were losing hope

[final chorus]
Mother, I know
You gave your whole life to mine
You buried sorrow in your chest
So I could reach the sky

Mother, I know
I cannot give your past back whole
But I can love you with this life
And make sure your story’s told

[outro]
I miss you more than I can say
I love you more than I can show
You were my shelter in the storm
My first and truest home

And if my life has any light
It started in your hands
You stayed alive because of me
But because of you, I stand
